Materials.Name: Ember
Materials.Text: A coal that never cools. Tier I crafts.

Materials.Name: Glyph Shard
Materials.Text: A shard of a dwarven glyph. Tier II crafts, and unmaking a crafted mod.

Materials.Name: Oathsteel
Materials.Text: Steel from a broken vow. Tier III crafts.

Materials.Name: Ember Whetstone
Materials.Text: Sharpens a weapon: +5% Quality on a white, +2% on magic, +1% on rare or unique, up to 20%.

Materials.Name: Ember Rivet
Materials.Text: Mends an armour piece: +5% Quality on a white, +2% on magic, +1% on rare or unique, up to 20%.

Materials.Name: Heartwood
Materials.Text: Living wood from Myrh Forest. Pays for the forest's recipes.

Materials.Name: Sunstone
Materials.Text: A stone that holds the desert's noon. Pays for the Desolated Plains' recipes.

Materials.Name: Frost-Iron
Materials.Text: Iron that never thaws. Pays for the snow lands' recipes.

Materials.Name: Massadian Essence
Materials.Text: Ember-light bottled in the Massadian Fire Lands. Pays for the Fire Lands' recipes.

Materials.Name: Bog Amber
Materials.Text: Sap the swamp turned to stone. Pays for the Kabarian Swamp's recipes.

Materials.Name: Gloomsilver
Materials.Text: Silver from lightless ground. Pays for Forge crafts: mod tiers, gem levels, damage over time.

Materials.Name: Oathcinder
Materials.Text: What is left when an oath burns. Spent to Unswear a rare, red or Oathword.

Materials.Name: Forgeheart
Materials.Text: A Rupture Lord's forge heart. Set into ONE item: its Forge Potential grows by a quarter. Mods stay.

Materials.Name: Oathmark Shard
Materials.Text: A splinter of an Oathmark. Three cut ONE jewel socket past the normal limit of a magic or rare item.

Materials.Name: Rivenstone
Materials.Text: A stone the Rupture swore on. At the Forge it turns ONE chosen T1 line into its Riven 0 (T0).

Materials.Name: Core Ember
Materials.Text: A coal from a Core Rupture, still burning with the broken oath. Tier IV: the Skyforge.

Recipes.Name: Hearthblood
Recipes.Text: Adds a crafted maximum Life prefix
Recipes.Line: Life first. Always life first.
Recipes.FoundIn: Known when the Forge opens

Recipes.Name: Unmake
Recipes.Text: Takes the crafted modifier off (the slot opens again)
Recipes.Line: Nothing I make is forever. That's the point.
Recipes.FoundIn: Known when the Forge opens

Recipes.Name: Ox Brand
Recipes.Text: Adds a crafted Strength suffix
Recipes.Line: Strength for the heavy gems.
Recipes.FoundIn: Forge Tablet, found in Myrh Forest

Recipes.Name: Hart Brand
Recipes.Text: Adds a crafted Dexterity suffix
Recipes.Line: Quick hands. A bow wants them.
Recipes.FoundIn: Forge Tablet, found in Myrh Forest

Recipes.Name: Owl Brand
Recipes.Text: Adds a crafted Intelligence suffix
Recipes.Line: Wit for the spell gems.
Recipes.FoundIn: Forge Tablet, found in Myrh Forest

Recipes.Name: Mossmend
Recipes.Text: Adds crafted Life Regeneration (a suffix)
Recipes.Line: The moss heals what it covers.
Recipes.FoundIn: Forge Tablet, found in Myrh Forest

Recipes.Name: Keen Edge
Recipes.Text: Adds crafted physical damage (melee weapons and bows; attacks on rings, gloves, amulets, quivers, chests)
Recipes.Line: A blade is only as good as its edge.
Recipes.FoundIn: Forge Tablet, found in Myrh Forest

Recipes.Name: Quickened Steel
Recipes.Text: Adds crafted attack or cast speed (melee weapons, bows, wands, staves, tomes, gloves, quivers, amulets)
Recipes.Line: Faster. The dead don't wait.
Recipes.FoundIn: Forge Tablet, found in Myrh Forest

Recipes.Name: Emberward
Recipes.Text: Adds a crafted Fire Resistance suffix
Recipes.Line: Sunstone drinks the heat. So will you.
Recipes.FoundIn: Forge Tablet, found in the Desolated Plains

Recipes.Name: Forgefire
Recipes.Text: Adds crafted fire damage (added fire on any weapon or a tome, increased fire damage on an amulet)
Recipes.Line: My own fire, in your steel.
Recipes.FoundIn: Forge Tablet, found in the Desolated Plains

Recipes.Name: Hawk's Eye
Recipes.Text: Adds a crafted critical strike chance suffix
Recipes.Line: Find the gap in the armour.
Recipes.FoundIn: Forge Tablet, found in the Desolated Plains

Recipes.Name: Wayfarer's Stride
Recipes.Text: Adds crafted movement speed to boots (a suffix)
Recipes.Line: Desert roads teach you to walk fast.
Recipes.FoundIn: Forge Tablet, found in the Desolated Plains

Recipes.Name: Rimeward
Recipes.Text: Adds a crafted Cold Resistance suffix
Recipes.Line: Frost-iron keeps the cold out.
Recipes.FoundIn: Forge Tablet, found in the Harmoniyan Lands

Recipes.Name: Frostplate
Recipes.Text: Adds crafted defence to armour, a shield or a tome; energy shield to rings, amulets, belts
Recipes.Line: Iron that never thaws, on your back.
Recipes.FoundIn: Forge Tablet, found in the Harmoniyan Lands

Recipes.Name: Rimeweave
Recipes.Text: Adds crafted flat energy shield to armour, shields, tomes, rings, amulets, belts (a prefix)
Recipes.Line: Frost spun thin enough to wear. It turns the blow before it lands.
Recipes.FoundIn: Forge Tablet, found in the Harmoniyan Lands

Recipes.Name: Rimebite
Recipes.Text: Adds crafted cold damage (added cold on any weapon or a tome, increased cold damage on an amulet)
Recipes.Line: Cold steel, in the true sense.
Recipes.FoundIn: Forge Tablet, found in the Harmoniyan Lands

Recipes.Name: Second Strike
Recipes.Text: Re-rolls the values of every modifier, each inside its own tier
Recipes.Line: Strike it again. Steel forgives.
Recipes.FoundIn: Forge Tablet, found in the Harmoniyan Lands

Recipes.Name: Graveward
Recipes.Text: Adds a crafted Poison Resistance suffix
Recipes.Line: The vents breathe poison. Breathe back.
Recipes.FoundIn: Forge Tablet, found in the Massadian Fire Lands

Recipes.Name: Spellcraft
Recipes.Text: Adds crafted increased spell damage to a wand, a staff, a rune dagger or a tome (a prefix)
Recipes.Line: The Deep Hold's glyphs still burn.
Recipes.FoundIn: Forge Tablet, found in the Massadian Fire Lands

Recipes.Name: Bloodbound
Recipes.Text: Adds crafted life leech or life on kill to a weapon, gloves or a ring (a suffix, a prefix on rings)
Recipes.Line: Take back what they take.
Recipes.FoundIn: Forge Tablet, found in the Massadian Fire Lands

Recipes.Name: Deep Temper
Recipes.Text: Adds crafted increased defences to armour, a shield or a tome (a prefix)
Recipes.Line: Quenched in Massadian fire, like my father's.
Recipes.FoundIn: Forge Tablet, found in the Massadian Fire Lands

Recipes.Name: Grave Brand
Recipes.Text: Adds a crafted minion mod: damage (wands, staves, tomes, scythes), life (helms, chests, belts, shields, tomes), speed (gloves, boots, amulets)
Recipes.Line: The dead answer to a brand they know.
Recipes.FoundIn: Forge Tablet, found in the Massadian Fire Lands

Recipes.Name: Stormward
Recipes.Text: Adds a crafted Lightning Resistance suffix
Recipes.Line: Amber stops the storm. Most of it.
Recipes.FoundIn: Forge Tablet, found in the Kabarian Swamp

Recipes.Name: Fen Spring
Recipes.Text: Adds crafted mana regeneration or mana on kill (a suffix)
Recipes.Line: The fen never runs dry.
Recipes.FoundIn: Forge Tablet, found in the Kabarian Swamp

Recipes.Name: Stormcall
Recipes.Text: Adds crafted lightning damage (added on any weapon or tome, increased on an amulet)
Recipes.Line: Bottle the storm. Hit with it.
Recipes.FoundIn: Forge Tablet, found in the Kabarian Swamp

Recipes.Name: Wellspring
Recipes.Text: Adds a crafted maximum Mana prefix
Recipes.Line: You've earned a deeper well.
Recipes.FoundIn: Edda teaches it at Forge level 2

Recipes.Name: Kindle
Recipes.Text: A plain item becomes magic, with one or two new mods
Recipes.Line: Plain steel, meet the fire.
Recipes.FoundIn: Edda teaches it at Forge level 2

Recipes.Name: Reforge
Recipes.Text: Every modifier rolls anew; the rarity stays (a crafted mod is lost)
Recipes.Line: Melt it down. Pour it again.
Recipes.FoundIn: Edda teaches it at Forge level 3

Recipes.Name: Crown of Steel
Recipes.Text: A magic item becomes rare: its mods stay and one more joins
Recipes.Line: Magic is a start. Let's make it rare.
Recipes.FoundIn: Edda teaches it at Forge level 3

Recipes.Name: Prefix Ward
Recipes.Text: The prefixes stay; every suffix rolls anew
Recipes.Line: Hold the front. Pour the back again.
Recipes.FoundIn: Edda teaches it at Forge level 4

Recipes.Name: Suffix Ward
Recipes.Text: The suffixes stay; every prefix rolls anew
Recipes.Line: Hold the back. Pour the front again.
Recipes.FoundIn: Edda teaches it at Forge level 4

Recipes.Name: Oathsteel Temper
Recipes.Text: The crafted modifier rises one tier (never to the best: drops stay the chase)
Recipes.Line: Oathsteel remembers a better shape.
Recipes.FoundIn: Forge Tablet, from a Guardian

Recipes.Name: Oathward
Recipes.Text: Adds crafted resistance to all elements to a ring or amulet (a suffix)
Recipes.Line: One vow against every element.
Recipes.FoundIn: Forge Tablet, from a Guardian

Recipes.Name: Deathblow
Recipes.Text: Adds a crafted critical strike multiplier to a weapon or amulet (a suffix)
Recipes.Line: When it lands, make it count.
Recipes.FoundIn: Forge Tablet, from a Guardian

Recipes.Name: Widening Glyph
Recipes.Text: Adds crafted area of effect to a helm or amulet (a suffix)
Recipes.Line: Wider. Let them all feel it.
Recipes.FoundIn: Forge Tablet, from a Guardian

Recipes.Name: Fletcher's Oath
Recipes.Text: Adds a crafted +1 to Level of all Skill Gems to a bow (a prefix)
Recipes.Line: A bowyer's oath: the string remembers every shot.
Recipes.FoundIn: Forge Tablet, from a Guardian

Recipes.Name: Vowkeeper's Blessing
Recipes.Text: A unique's values re-roll inside their ranges
Recipes.Line: Even a legend can be struck again.
Recipes.FoundIn: Forge Tablet, from a Guardian

Recipes.Name: Whetstone
Recipes.Text: Re-rolls the value of ONE chosen mod, inside its own tier
Recipes.Line: Pick the one that bothers you. I'll grind it again.
Recipes.FoundIn: Known when the Forge opens

Recipes.Name: Recast
Recipes.Text: Melts ONE chosen mod out; a new one of the same kind (prefix or suffix) pours in
Recipes.Line: Out with the bad line. The mould remembers its shape.
Recipes.FoundIn: Edda teaches it at Forge level 2

Recipes.Name: Deep Quench
Recipes.Text: Every mod rolls a new tier and value the item level allows (a crafted mod stays)
Recipes.Line: Quench it deep. It comes out better, or it doesn't.
Recipes.FoundIn: Edda teaches it at Forge level 3

Recipes.Name: Chisel
Recipes.Text: Chisels ONE chosen mod off; its slot opens for a crafted one
Recipes.Line: Show me the line you hate. I'll cut it clean.
Recipes.FoundIn: Known when the Forge opens

Recipes.Name: Anneal
Recipes.Text: ONE chosen mod goes a tier better (never the best tier: drops keep that)
Recipes.Line: Heat, patience, a lighter hammer. It comes back stronger.
Recipes.FoundIn: Edda teaches it at Forge level 2

Recipes.Name: Add
Recipes.Text: A chosen mod joins an open slot at the lowest tier, paid with one of its Echoes
Recipes.Line: Pick the line you want. The Echo knows the way in.
Recipes.FoundIn: Known when the Forge opens

Recipes.Name: Temper up
Recipes.Text: ONE chosen mod goes a tier better, paid with one of its Echoes
Recipes.Line: Feed it its own echo. It remembers being stronger.
Recipes.FoundIn: Known when the Forge opens

Recipes.Name: Reroll value
Recipes.Text: ONE chosen mod's value rolls again inside its tier
Recipes.Line: One more pass of the grinder.
Recipes.FoundIn: Known when the Forge opens

Recipes.Name: Remove
Recipes.Text: ONE chosen mod comes off; its slot opens
Recipes.Line: Cut it out clean. The slot is yours again.
Recipes.FoundIn: Known when the Forge opens

Recipes.Name: Socket
Recipes.Text: Bores a jewel socket into a magic or rare weapon, body armour, helmet or shield (magic 2, rare 1)
Recipes.Line: Hold still. A good hole is a kind of promise.
Recipes.FoundIn: Known when the Forge opens

Recipes.Name: Skyforged Temper
Recipes.Text: The crafted modifier rises one tier, even to the best tier
Recipes.Line: Core fire. Hotter than anything I own. Hold it steady.
Recipes.FoundIn: Learnt with your first Core Ember (a Core Rupture's Lord)

Recipes.Name: Skyforged Anneal
Recipes.Text: ONE chosen mod goes a tier better, even to the best tier
Recipes.Line: This is the heat the old smiths dreamt of. One line. Make it count.
Recipes.FoundIn: Learnt with your first Core Ember (a Core Rupture's Lord)

Recipes.Name: Hone
Recipes.Text: Quality +1% (to 10%): more of the item's own defences or physical damage
Recipes.Line: Long strokes. Let the stone do the work.
Recipes.FoundIn: Known when the Forge opens

Recipes.Name: Oathsteel Hone
Recipes.Text: Quality +1% (from 10% to 20%)
Recipes.Line: Past ten, only oathsteel bites. Slower now.
Recipes.FoundIn: Known when the Forge opens

Recipes.Name: Skyforged Hone
Recipes.Text: Quality +1% past 20%: 3 Core Embers, 3 more for each point after
Recipes.Line: Nobody hones past twenty. Nobody but us.
Recipes.FoundIn: Learnt with your first Core Ember (a Core Rupture's Lord)

Recipes.Name: Ember Whetstone
Recipes.Text: Weapon Quality: +5% on a white, +2% magic, +1% rare or unique, up to 20%
Recipes.Line: Draw it toward you. Let the edge drink the ember.
Recipes.FoundIn: Known when the Forge opens

Recipes.Name: Ember Rivet
Recipes.Text: Armour Quality: +5% on a white, +2% magic, +1% rare or unique, up to 20%
Recipes.Line: One hot rivet, one clean strike.
Recipes.FoundIn: Known when the Forge opens

Recipes.Name: Lightless Anneal
Recipes.Text: ONE chosen mod goes a tier better (the best tier from Rupture Level 160), paid in Gloomsilver
Recipes.Line: Grown in the dark. It makes good steel a little better.
Recipes.FoundIn: Known when the Forge opens

Recipes.Name: Unswear
Recipes.Text: Unswear a rare, red or Oathword: 5% destroys it; Forge and Cube then cannot change it
Recipes.Line: An oath breaks once. What it leaves, you keep.
Recipes.FoundIn: Known when the Forge opens

Recipes.Name: Forgeheart
Recipes.Text: Set a Forgeheart into one magic or rare item: its Forge Potential grows by a quarter for good
Recipes.Line: Hearts burn long. Put one where it will matter.
Recipes.FoundIn: Known when the Forge opens

Recipes.Name: Oathmark Shard
Recipes.Text: Cut one jewel socket past the normal limit of a magic or rare item
Recipes.Line: Three shards, one more place for a jewel.
Recipes.FoundIn: Known when the Forge opens

Recipes.Name: Rivenstone
Recipes.Text: ONE chosen T1 mod becomes its Riven 0 (T0), one step above the T1 top
Recipes.Line: Some oaths hold past breaking. This one holds a line.
Recipes.FoundIn: Known when the Forge opens

Recipes.Name: Rivenhold
Recipes.Text: Cut one Dwarven Rune Socket into a rare ring, belt or boots (24 Rivenstones)
Recipes.Line: Two dozen splinters of a broken oath. Enough to hold a rune.
Recipes.FoundIn: Known when the Forge opens

Recipes.Name: Oathbind
Recipes.Text: Bind 6 Red Shards into their red: lay a plain (white) item of that red's base here (3 Oathsteel)
Recipes.Line: Six pieces of one promise. The steel remembers the rest.
Recipes.FoundIn: Known when the Forge opens

Recipes.Name: Riven Bind
Recipes.Text: Bind 6 Red Shards into their red with every line at its best roll: lay a plain (white) item of that red's base here (6 Rivenstones, 3 Oathsteel)
Recipes.Line: Six shards, six stones. Nothing is left to chance.
Recipes.FoundIn: Known when the Forge opens

Recipes.Name: Red Forge
Recipes.Text: Forge a red from nothing: lay a plain (white) item of that red's base here, item level at least the red's. Each Red Forge this league costs more
Recipes.Line: No shard, no promise. Only the heart of a forge and what you pay it.
Recipes.FoundIn: Known when the Forge opens

Recipes.Name: Gloomsight
Recipes.Text: Adds +1 Level to all Skill Gems (prefix): amulet, helm, tome, wand, staff, melee weapon. Gloomsilver.
Recipes.Line: What you learn in the dark, you keep.
Recipes.FoundIn: Known when the Forge opens

Recipes.Name: Black Below Rot
Recipes.Text: Adds a damage over time multiplier (prefix) to a weapon, amulet, quiver or tome. Gloomsilver.
Recipes.Line: Down there everything rots a little faster.
Recipes.FoundIn: Known when the Forge opens

Recipes.Name: Abyssal Ward
Recipes.Text: Adds physical damage taken as elemental (suffix) to a chest, shield or helm. Gloomsilver.
Recipes.Line: The deep turns a blow into cold fire.
Recipes.FoundIn: Known when the Forge opens

Recipes.Name: Lampwick
Recipes.Text: Adds crafted cooldown recovery to an amulet or a weapon (a suffix), paid in Gloomsilver
Recipes.Line: Trim the wick, light it again.
Recipes.FoundIn: Known when the Forge opens
